hints.title: Key Insight and Observation
hints.text: A bitonic array increases to a single peak element and then decreases.

hints.title: Algorithmic Strategy and State
hints.text: Identify the peak index by advancing while adjacent elements increase.

hints.title: Optimal Boundary and Processing
hints.text: Sum both halves inclusive of the peak and return comparison indicator.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Single linear pass locates peak and computes segment sums.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Recalculating partition sums repeatedly is suboptimal.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Finds bitonic peak and computes part sums in linear time.
